_note: R-102. Before this fixture the repository contained two `for` loops, both zero-start and incrementing, so the ANF loop node's `start` field — which every tier implements and carries explicitly — was exercised by nothing. Two wrong-value miscompiles were living behind that: Go's constant folder dropped Start and Step (N-128), and Zig's .runar.go / .runar.java parsers dropped the init value (N-129). Both produced a script computing a DIFFERENT NUMBER than the source, and both were invisible to a corpus of zero-start loops.

spends.note: seed 0 + (3+4+5+6) = 18 — the non-zero START is what makes this 18 and not 6 (Go folded it to 0+1+2+3) or 21 (Zig unrolled 0..6)
seed 1 gives 19; the assert must fail. A loop that summed a different range would land on a different total and this pair pins which.
